name: Rewards In Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are promised significant rewards in heaven for their faithfulness and godly conduct, as Jesus encourages rejoicing in the face of persecution because of the great heavenly reward awaiting His followers (Matthew 5:12). Acts of righteousness such as giving alms and prayer, done in secret, are seen and rewarded openly by the Father (Matthew 6:4, 6). At His return, Christ will reward each person according to their works, affirming faithful stewardship with increased responsibility and joy in His presence (Matthew 16:27; 25:21). Moreover, investing in eternal treasures through generosity secures an imperishable reward beyond earthly decay or loss (Luke 12:33).
